items.content:
Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.

Language: JavaScript
Stars: 9200
Forks: 1144
items.contentSnippet:
Self-hosted gym & body-weight tracker — plan routines, log workouts (supersets, warm-ups, cardio), see which muscles are trained, fatigued or detrained, import from FitNotes/Strong/Hevy, passkey login. Your data, your server.
Language: JavaScript
Stars: 9200
Forks: 1144
items.creator: DuarteSantos8

summaries.zh: 这是一个基于JavaScript的个人自托管健身房和体重跟踪应用，支持制定训练计划、记录训练（包括超级组、热身和有氧运动），并显示肌肉训练、疲劳或未训练状态。可从FitNotes/Strong/Hevy导入数据，采用Passkey登录。用户数据存储在自建服务器上。项目在GitHub上获得5496星和759次分叉。
summaries.en: The openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. Users can plan routines, log workouts (including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio), track muscle status (trained, fatigued, or detrained), and import data from FitNotes, Strong, or Hevy. It features passkey login and emphasizes user data control on a self-server basis. Developed in JavaScript, the project has 5,496 stars and 759 forks on GitHub.
